name: VultronCoderAtlas-Kimi-K3-2T
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from moonshotai/Kimi-K3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1048576). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: hybrid: Gated MLA on 24 layers + Kimi Delta Attention on 69 layers, with Attention Residuals
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A REAP expert-pruned compression of moonshotai/Kimi-K3, not a repack and not a same-tensor derivative: the card states 672 of the base's 896 routed experts are retained in each of the 92 MoE layers, so num_experts is set to the card's 672 rather than the inherited 896, and the packed checkpoint is 1.199 TB against the base's 1.561 TB. Top-16 routing, 2 shared experts per MoE layer, the vision tower, tokenizer and the 1,048,576-token context are preserved; shared-expert, attention, embedding and vision tensors are byte-for-byte the source's per the card. Safetensors total 2099.099B (BF16 57.0B + U8 2042.1B packed experts) against the base record's 2780B - the two are not the same tensor set. Recorded as a contender because the card publishes one table with both a Kimi K3 column and an Atlas column. That table mixes two bases: the four winning rows (HumanEval+, MBPP+, SWE-bench Verified, LiveCodeBench v6) are 'Local Kimi Code Harness', i.e. the vendor re-ran the base itself; the losing rows (DeepSWE v1.1, MMMU-Pro) are 'Moonshot published', i.e. cross-source, and Terminal-Bench 2.1 / BFCL v4 are local but also below base. All eight rows recorded, losses included. Licence other, repo created 2026-09-02.
